pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the seabed band (y 780-1080) vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.33 px every frame (scripts/bg.py); seabed outline identical in frames 0 and 47
camera.perspective: side view of underwater scene; seabed dunes in the lower quarter (crest near y~800 at x 800-1100). The turtle swims horizontally (y constant within ~1.6 px) and its rest-pose size is constant once fully in frame -> treat as motion in a plane facing the camera, one px scale.

objects.name: turtle
objects.description: the only animal / moving object: a dark-blue sea turtle (leatherback-like, ridged carapace), side view, head pointing LEFT, swimming leftward across mid-frame at y~490-625
objects.partially_out_of_frame: frames 0-20: rear part cut by the right image edge (x=1919); fully visible from frame 21

reference_points.shell_x, shell_y (RECOMMENDED for displa: carapace template-matching track, integrated from per-frame shell displacements and anchored to the mask centroid at frame 47; rigid, unaffected by flipper strokes. Frames 0-~10 its value lies right of the visible part (body centre still off-screen).
reference_points.shell_dx, shell_dy: carapace displacement from frame i-1 to i (px), directly measured
reference_points.mask_cx, mask_cy: centroid of the full segmented mask (includes flippers; biased while truncated, frames 0-20, and wobbles with the flipper stroke)
reference_points.bbox_*: bounding box of the full mask (flippers included)

size_px_when_fully_visible.bbox_length_x_px: 298-312 (mean ~305) head tip to rear-flipper tip; 323 at frame 47 where the far front flipper starts to swing forward; 314-326 during frames 21-36
size_px_when_fully_visible.bbox_height_y_px: 130-131 at frames 40-47 (y 493-623); up to ~215 at frames 21-23 when the front flipper is stroked down
size_px_when_fully_visible.body_height_px: ~105 (body_y0..body_y1 at frames 39-46, shell top y~493 to belly y~597)
size_px_when_fully_visible.note: Blender world AABB of an animated mesh changes with the flipper pose; pick the frame/pose the question implies. Extent across the image plane (depth) is not observable.

position_examples.frame_0: visible head tip x=1776, y~550; shell_x 1952.7 (off-screen)

objects.name: seabed
objects.description: pale sandy dunes across the bottom of the frame, lit by moving teal caustic light patches
objects.extent_px: spans full width x 0-1919; top edge ~y 800 (crest x 800-1100), ~y 830 at x=0, ~y 870 at x=1900; to bottom of frame y=1079
objects.note: caustic spots (teal ellipses) and light shafts from the surface shimmer/move; they are lighting, not objects

objects.name: water / light shafts
objects.description: blue water background with vertical sun rays; static camera, rays flicker slightly

events.event: turtle already moving leftward at frame 0 (shell displacement frame 0->1 = -0.71 px), carapace displacement per frame grows steadily every frame to -42.6 px at frame 47 (speeding up throughout, no stop, no reversal)
front flippers begin downward/backward power stroke (bbox bottom moves down from y 595)
front flipper stroke at its lowest (bbox bottom y ~735)
turtle fully inside the frame (bbox right edge leaves x=1919)
flippers returned to folded rest pose along body (bbox height back to ~130 px)
far front flipper starts next forward swing (left bbox edge jumps ahead of head)

files.scripts/: bg.py (camera check), seg.py (first segmentation test), track.py (mask track -> turtle.csv), shellshift.py (carapace template track, adds shell_* columns), probe16.py (noise probe)
